company.what_they_do: web-library.net is a free/public email service provider — it supplies email addresses to end users, positioning itself as a legitimate (non-throwaway) public email platform. It explicitly prohibits illegal use, does not allow outbound messages to the internet, and asks receiving services not to block its domain. It provides an abuse-reporting ticket system.
